name: ga-company-formation
description: Gabon company-formation reference for SARL, SA and SAS structures, capital funding, registered office, RCCM and tax registration. Use for incorporation, entity choice, ANPI and GNI questions, with OHADA statutory defaults distinguished from unverified Gabon national derogations and current administrative requirements. Use this Guide to identify the facts, statutory computation and source documents needed before preparing a working paper. It separates the historical code baseline from the enacted finance-law amendments read for this draft. It does not certify the complete 2026 amendment chain or authenticated filing screens. Missing procedures and unresolved old topics are listed explicitly, and the pack remains partial until those gaps and independent review are complete.
